# js-sha256

- Registry SHA-512 integrity: `sha512-o6WSo/LUvY2uC4j7mO50a2ms7E/EAdbP0swigLV+nzHKTTaYnaLIWJ02VdXrsJX0vGedDESQnLsOekr94ryfjg==`

`sha256.js` is the unmodified package's `src/sha256.js`; its license is alongside it. `native-values.js` selects its documented pure JavaScript browser mode for UXP. No runtime download or Node crypto shim is required. Fingerprints keep full transcript copies out of native ownership metadata while SQLite/readback can retain the evidence.
